blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change. World Action Models (WAMs) learn to predict future visual observations, but their training objectives typically leave the underlying 3D geometric transitions implicit. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Foresight Forcing ($\mathcal{F}^{2}$), a WAM that learns a spatial transition representation from changes in a pretrained 3D feature space. During training, a frozen 3D foundation model extracts patch-wise feature differences from aligned current and future observations that provide dense supervision for geometry-aware feature transitions. We distill these targets into spatial transition queries, which are progressively refined from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and use them alongside current visual features to generate actions. At deployment, the policy predicts the queries without future observations or the 3D teacher. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, including 95.01% average success on RoboTwin2.0 Full. On six real-world manipulation tasks, $\mathcal{F}^{2}$ achieves a mean task score of 85.8%.
blocks.zh: 机器人操纵政策可以通过预测物体如何移动及其空间关系的变化来改进动作预测. 世界行动模型(WAMS)学习预测未来的视觉观测,但其培训目标通常会暗含基本的3D几何过渡. 为了缓解这个问题,我们引入了Foresight Forcing (\ mathcal{F}^{2}$),这是一个从预先训练的3D特性空间的变化中学习空间过渡表现的WAM. 在训练期间,一个冷冻的3D基础模型从对齐的当前和未来的观测中提取出补丁式特征差异,为几何感知特征过渡提供密集的监管. 我们把这些目标提炼成空间过渡查询,这些查询从目前的观测、语言教学和自主状态逐步完善,并结合目前的视觉特征加以利用,以产生行动。 部署时,政策预测询问时没有未来观察或3D老师. 关于LIBERO,LIBERO-Plus,和RoboTwin2.0的实验表现出强大的操纵性能和增强的稳健性,包括RoboTwin2.0 Full上95.01%的平均成功率. 在六个现实世界操纵任务上,$\ mathcal{F}^{2}$实现85.8%的平均任务分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Robotic manipulation has progressed from task-specific systems designed for controlled environments towards generalist policies that operate across diverse objects, instructions, and settings. A general-purpose robot must interpret task instructions, perceive objects in its surroundings, and execute precise actions under varying conditions. Recent advances in large-scale robot learning and pretrained vision-language models have enabled Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies to map visual observations and natural-language instructions to robot actions Zitkovich et al. (2023) ; Kim et al. (2025b) ; Black et al. (2025b) ; Black et al. (2025a) ; Kim et al. (2025a) .
However, action labels do not directly supervise the visual outcomes of those actions. To incorporate this information into policy learning, World Action Models (WAMs) build on visual generative models and couple action learning with world modeling objectives Zhang et al. (2026b) ; Cen et al. (2025) ; Bi et al. (2026) ; Yuan et al. (2026) . The resulting visual prediction task provides an additional training signal alongside action supervision and enables robot policies to benefit from pretrained generative representations.

机器人操纵已经从为受控制环境设计的针对特定任务的系统发展到跨不同对象、指示和设置的通用政策。 通用机器人必须解释任务指令,在周围感知物体,并在不同条件下执行精确动作. 近期在大规模机器人学习和预先训练的视觉语言模型方面取得的进展,使Vision-Language-Action(VLA)政策能够绘制视觉观测图,并为机器人动作Zitkovich等人(2023年);Kim等人(2025b年); Black等人(2025b); Black等人(2025a); Kim 等人 (2025a).
然而,行动标签并不直接监督这些行动的视觉结果。 为了将这一信息纳入政策学习,世界行动模式以视觉遗传模式为基础,结合世界示范目标开展双向行动学习。 张等 (2026b) ; Cen 等 (2025) ; Bi 等 (2026) ; 袁等 (2026) . 由此产生的视觉预测任务,除了动作监督之外,还提供了额外的培训信号,使机器人政策能够从事先经过训练的基因表达中受益。

blocks.en:
Most WAMs learn how a scene evolves by predicting future RGB observations or visual latents. These objectives encode task-relevant spatial relationships alongside object appearance, background, and viewpoint, leaving the geometric transitions that matter for control implicit.
Geometry Forcing shows that pretrained 3D features can improve the geometric consistency of video generation Wu et al. (2026) , and geometry-aware WAMs have explored geometric supervision for manipulation Ma et al. (2026a) ; Zhang et al. (2026a) ; Li et al. (2026c) .
For robot control, the 3D changes needed to advance the task provide a natural target for this supervision.
Placing an object requires changing its pose relative to a target, while opening a drawer requires changing the configuration of an articulated object.
Modeling such transitions gives the policy a way to anticipate how the scene needs to change when generating actions.

放置一个对象需要改变相对于目标的位置,而打开抽屉则需要改变一个表达对象的配置.
模拟这种过渡使政策能够预测产生行动时场景需要如何改变。

blocks.en: Therefore, we introduce Foresight Forcing ( ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} ), a WAM that fuses correspondence-aligned transitions in 3D geometry feature space of foundation models into spatial transition queries for action generation, rather than directly predicting explicit 3D motions (Figure 1 ). During training, a frozen VGGT teacher Wang et al. (2025a) extracts patch features from an aligned observation pair, and their temporal differences serve as dense targets for the queries. A shared updater progressively refines the queries after each double block of the visual backbone using information from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state. We supervise the queries to match the direction and scale of the teacher targets and feed the refined queries directly to the action expert. At inference, the policy predicts the queries from its current inputs without access to future observations or the teacher. We evaluate ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks to assess manipulation performance, robustness, and inference efficiency. ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real robot.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Transition-centric geometric supervision. We introduce correspondence-aligned 3D teacher feature differences as supervision for spatial transition learning for action generation in a World Action Model. • Teacher-guided spatial transition learning for action generation. We introduce dedicated latent queries that a shared updater progressively refines across the visual backbone. During training, we align the refined queries with the frozen 3D teacher targets in direction and scale. The queries directly condition the action expert. • Manipulation performance and robustness. Evaluations on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, with state-of-the-art average success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 Full and Clean-to-Random. On six real-world tasks, ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} achieves a mean task score of 85.8%, exceeding ImageWAM and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} by 15.6 and 2.3 percentage points, respectively.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Building on this framework, ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} introduces spatial transition queries that encode task-relevant geometric changes over the action horizon. During training, a frozen 3D teacher supplies feature differences between aligned current and future observations as dense targets. The queries condition action generation alongside current visual features; neither future observations nor the teacher is required at deployment (Figure 2 ). We formulate the task in Sec. 3.1 , construct the geometric transition target in Sec. 3.2 , explain how the queries learn from it in Sec. 3.3 , and detail training and deployment in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)联合预测未来的观测和机器人行动. 在这个框架的基础上,F 2\ mathcal{F}^{2}引入了空间过渡查询,将与任务相关的几何变化编码在动作视野上. 在培训期间,冻结的三维教师用品将当前和未来一致的观测结果之间的差别作为密集的目标。 询问条件动作生成与当前视觉特征同时进行;部署时不需要未来观测或老师(图2 )。 我们以第3.1节制定任务,在第3.2节构建几何过渡目标,在第3.3节解释询问如何从中吸取教训,在第3.4节详细说明培训和部署情况。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} on LIBERO Liu et al. (2023) , LIBERO-Plus Fei et al. (2026) , RoboTwin 2.0 Chen et al. (2026a) , and real-world manipulation tasks. LIBERO is a single-arm simulation benchmark; we evaluate its Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long suites, each containing 10 tasks. LIBERO-Plus tests robustness across seven perturbation dimensions: object layout, camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language instruction, lighting, background, and observation noise. RoboTwin 2.0 comprises 50 dual-arm manipulation tasks in simulated tabletop scenes, including object placement, stacking, tool use, and articulated-object interaction. We evaluate both its Full and Clean-to-Random settings under clean and randomized scenes. For real-world evaluation, we compare three methods on six manipulation tasks.

blocks.en: We first examine whether the queries benefit from a teacher target. In the supervision-target comparison in Figure 3 , feature-delta supervision improves success from 82.3% without distillation to 84.5%, indicating a contribution beyond the additional query tokens. We then compare what the teacher supplies: the aligned feature difference outperforms both current- and future-feature targets, which reach 83.2% and 81.2%, respectively. Unlike an individual-frame target, the feature difference relates the paired observations and supervises how their teacher representations change; however, the target remains a feature-space representation rather than a direct measurement of 3D motion.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} learns spatial transition queries from correspondence-aligned changes in pretrained 3D features. These queries provide the Action Expert with a representation of anticipated spatial change, connecting geometric supervision during training to action generation from current observations. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and six real-world tasks show strong manipulation performance and improved robustness. Together, the results suggest that supervising how a scene changes in 3D feature space is a useful complement to future-image prediction in world action models. Studying how spatial transition learning generalizes across broader tasks, embodiments, and environments is an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh: F 2\ mathcal{F}^{2}从预训3D特性的函式变化中学习空间过渡查询. 这些查询使行动专家能够反映预期的空间变化,将培训期间的几何监督与从当前观测产生的行动联系起来。 关于LIBERO,LIBERO-Plus,RoboTwin 2.0的实验,以及六个现实世界的任务,都显示出强大的操控性能和更强的稳健性. 研究结果表明,监督一个场景如何改变3D特征空间是对世界行动模型中未来图像预测的有益补充。 研究空间过渡学习如何概括更广泛的任务、表现和环境,是未来研究的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: For Figure 4 (a), we compute the channel-wise ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm of the aligned VGGT feature difference alongside the corresponding prediction from the trained geometry head. External-camera maps are bilinearly upsampled from the 14 × 14 14\times 14 patch grid and rendered under a shared color scale and response threshold to emphasize salient regions. Both maps are overlaid on an equal blend of the current and observed-future frames separated by H = 16 H=16 steps. Future frames are used only to compute the teacher target and visualization background; student queries are predicted solely from the current observation and language instruction.
blocks.zh: 就图4(a)而言,我们计算对齐的VGGT的频道1 2\ell\\2}规范的特征差异,以及来自训练有素的几何头的相应预测。 外部摄像头地图是用14×14 14\时14的补丁网格进行双线性改进,在共同的颜色尺度和响应阈值下提供,以强调突出区域. 两幅地图均覆盖在由H=16 H=16步分隔的电流和观测到的未来框架的平面混合上. 未来帧仅用于计算教师目标和可视化背景;学生查询完全从当前观察和语言教学中预测.

blocks.en: For Figure 4 (b), we freeze the trained policy and fit a lightweight two-layer MLP probe to automatically tracked point correspondences. Taking local and pooled Z Δ Z_{\Delta} features together with the current query coordinates as input, the probe predicts 2D image-space displacements and is used strictly for post-hoc visualization. Query points are sampled within visible object regions in the current frame, and CoTracker3 Karaev et al. (2025) tracks them across observed video clips as well as current/ImageWAM-generated image pairs. We retain tracks that remain visible within image bounds and satisfy a 2-pixel forward–backward cycle consistency check. Observed future frames are withheld from both probe prediction and generated-image localization. The plate example is drawn from the held-out probe test split, whereas the mug and book examples come from its training split; CoTracker3 trajectories serve as estimated correspondence references.
blocks.zh: 对于图4(b),我们冻结训练有素的政策,并安装一个轻量级的双层MLP探测器,以自动跟踪点通信。 探测器将本地和集合的Z QQDelta 特性与当前查询坐标一起作为输入,预测2D图像-空间的位移,严格用于后热可视化. 查询点在目前框架的可见物体区域内进行取样,CoTracker3 Karaev等人(2025年)通过观测到的视频片段以及当前/ImageWAM生成的图像对进行跟踪. 我们保留在图像界限内仍然可见的轨迹,并满足2-像素向后循环一致性检查。 探测器预测和生成图像本地化均不考虑观测到的未来帧。 板块实例取自搁置的探测器测试拆分,而杯子和书本实例取自其训练拆分; CoTracker3轨迹作为估计的对应参考.

blocks.en: A.6 Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: A.6 数据增强

blocks.en: During training, we apply synchronized image augmentations across frames within each camera view, including resized cropping, rotation, color jitter, gamma adjustment, and Gaussian noise. Under the RoboTwin Clean-to-Random setting, following PatchWAM Wang et al. (2026c) , we additionally apply stronger appearance augmentations comprising photometric jitter, Gaussian blur, AdaIN-style feature-statistic perturbation, and Fourier amplitude modulation. Spatial transformations are shared between student and teacher inputs so geometric correspondence is preserved, whereas appearance augmentations are applied solely to the student inputs.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,我们在每个相机视图中应用同步图像增强,包括调整裁剪大小、旋转、色调、伽玛调整和高斯噪音。 在RoboTwin Clean-to-Random的设定下,继PatchWAM Wang等人(2026年c)之后,我们额外应用了更强的外观增强法,包括光度测振、高斯模糊、AdaIN式特征统计扰动和Fourier振幅调制。 空间转换由学生和教师投入共享,从而保留了几何通信,而外观增强则仅适用于学生投入。

blocks.en: All runs start from the InternData-A1-pretrained ImageWAM model and use the same clean RoboTwin demonstrations and 50-task C2R benchmark. The ImageWAM baseline is trained for 50 epochs without additional appearance augmentation and obtains 70.35% average success. Our main result trains ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} for the same 50-epoch stage, followed by 20 additional epochs with additional augmentation, reaching 77.45%. blocks.en: Continuing the same 50-epoch ImageWAM baseline for 20 more epochs with ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} but without additional augmentation yields 82.32%, 60.04%, and 71.18% on clean, randomized, and average success, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在F 2\ mathcal{F}^{2}的另外20个时间段上继续使用同样的50个时间段的图像WAM基准,但没有增加82.32%、60.04%和71.18%的纯度、随机度和平均成功率。

blocks.en: Table 12 summarizes the training variants and results. Additional augmentation improves the ImageWAM baseline from 70.35% to 76.00%, while ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} further improves the augmented result to 77.45%. Without augmentation, ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} reaches 71.18%, exceeding the ImageWAM baseline. The 0.83-point improvement over ImageWAM without additional augmentation supports the benefit of introducing transition supervision. Under the augmented schedule, ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} also outperforms ImageWAM by 1.45 points, providing further evidence of its contribution. These results support the value of transition supervision both with and without additional augmentation.

blocks.en: C.1 Setup and Evaluation Protocol

blocks.en: For the real-world comparison, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , ImageWAM, and ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} are each jointly trained on six bimanual manipulation tasks: cup stacking, towel folding, egg transfer, breakfast preparation, tool stowing, and size sorting. Every task is evaluated over 15 trials. Cup stacking, towel folding, egg transfer, and breakfast preparation are scored by full-task completion, whereas tool stowing (4 tools per trial) and size sorting (15 blocks per trial) are scored per item. The overall score is the unweighted mean across all six tasks. Figure 8 visualizes representative rollouts.

blocks.en: C.2 Task Success Criteria
blocks.zh: C.2 任务成功标准

blocks.en: The robot unstacks a nested pile of cups into a horizontal row and then stacks them into a pyramid. A trial succeeds if the entire sequence finishes within the time limit. Minor execution errors (e.g., missed grasps, tipped cups, or overlapping placements) are permitted if the policy autonomously recovers and completes the pyramid within the allotted time; otherwise, the trial fails.
blocks.zh: 机器人将堆积的杯子放入水平排,然后堆积成金字塔. 如果整个序列在时限内完成,则审判成功。 如果政策在分配的时间内自动恢复并完成金字塔,则允许出现小的执行错误(如抓错、漏掉杯子或重叠放置);否则审判失败。

blocks.en: The robot folds a flat towel in half, folds it in half a second time, and presses the folded cloth flat. A trial succeeds only if all three steps are completed cleanly; failure at any stage counts as a failed trial.
blocks.zh: 机器人将一块平整的毛巾折成两半,半次折叠,按下折叠的布料平整. 只有清理完成所有三个步骤,审判才能成功;任何阶段的失败都算作审判失败。

blocks.en: The robot transfers eggs from a source carton into designated slots in a destination tray. A trial succeeds when all eggs are properly seated in the tray; rolling eggs or visibly misplaced placements count as failure.
blocks.zh: 机器人将鸡蛋从源卡顿转移到目的地托盘的指定槽. 当所有鸡蛋都妥善放在托盘里时,试验就成功;滚蛋或明显错误的放置算作失败。

blocks.en: The robot sequentially places a slice of bread, a fried egg, a second slice of bread, a banana, and a carrot onto a plate. A trial succeeds if the full assembly completes within the time limit, including autonomous recovery from intermediate mistakes; any incomplete sequence counts as failure.
blocks.zh: 机器人依次将一块面包,一个炸鸡蛋,一个第二片面包,一个香蕉,一个胡萝卜放在盘子上. 如果全部组装在时限内完成,包括从中间错误中自动恢复,则审判成功;任何不完整的序列都算作失败。

blocks.en: Each trial presents four articulated tools to be placed into fitted organizer slots in a toolbox. We score the fraction of tools stowed successfully; if a tool fails, it is marked as a failure and an operator places it so the policy can proceed to the remaining tools. The reported score is the total number of stowed tools divided by 60 across 15 trials.
blocks.zh: 每一次试验都提供四个明确的工具,将放在工具箱内安装的组织者槽中。 我们成功得分工具的分数;如果一个工具失败,它被标记为失败,操作员将其放置,这样政策就可以继续使用剩下的工具. 报告的得分是,在15次试验中,被授予的工具总数除以60。

blocks.en: Each trial contains 15 blocks to be sorted by size into a large box and a small box. We report the mean fraction of correctly sorted blocks across 15 trials. A block counts as a failure if the robot fails to grasp it, selects the wrong box, or drops it outside the target box.
blocks.zh: 每个试验包含15个块,按大小排序成一个大盒子和一个小盒子. 我们报告在15个审判中正确分类的区块的一小部分。 如果机器人未能抓住它,选择错误的框,或者将其扔到目标框之外,一个块算作失败.

blocks.en: We apply an identical diagnostic procedure to ImageWAM and ℱ 2 \mathcal{F}^{2} on randomized RoboTwin observations (Figure 5 ), holding the current RGB inputs, proprioceptive state, instruction, and sampling seed fixed within each pair to compare the two methods under matched inputs.

(2021) , combining head-averaged positive attention–gradient products with additive residual transport across the image backbone, shared query updater, and Action Expert. Attribution targets the first action’s left-gripper component at the final denoising step with earlier action latents held fixed. Routes are grouped by their entry edge into the action stream and normalized over all three camera views (only the head view is displayed).
